claim.definition: A formally asserted sovereignty or title unsupported by effective control over the claimed whole on the start date.

composite-realm.definition: Distinct constitutional territories united under one ruler while retaining separate laws or institutions.

concession.definition: Territory or jurisdiction granted to an external commercial or political community by a host ruler.

condominium.definition: Territory subject to formally shared superior authority by two or more rulers.

dependency.definition: A governed possession subordinate to another polity and not merely a normal contiguous administrative division.

detached-territory.definition: Territory governed by a polity but geographically separated from its principal contiguous lands.

disputed-area.definition: Territory whose sovereignty or required return was actively contested by identifiable political authorities on the start date.

enclave-exclave.definition: A territory wholly or almost wholly surrounded by another polity, recorded from the enclave or governing-polity perspective.

free-protected-city.definition: A city polity with legally evidenced civic autonomy, imperial immediacy, protection, or comparable protected status.

microstate.definition: A territorially very small self-governing polity represented separately because size would otherwise erase it.

non-state-territory.definition: Territory administered by a durable organized community that was neither a conventional dynastic state nor an ordinary subdivision.
